youtube_title: Jesus... I Called Her Gift My Favourite | Ephesians 4:25 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Jesus's Replies — an imagined reply from Jesus to a real, unspoken prayer.

She told her athai her Diwali gift is her favourite when it is not, and the small lie is eating at her.

She: Jesus... Athai's Diwali gift. Why did I call it my favourite? 🎁
She: She spent her bonus on it. It sits in my cupboard and I feel sick.
Jesus: The lie was small. It costs you the truth with someone who loves you.
She: If I tell her, she'll be hurt. Isn't hiding it kinder?
Jesus: Kindness that needs a lie isn't kindness. It's a debt you keep paying.

“Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to his neighbor, for we are all members of one another.”
Ephesians 4:25 (BSB)

Honour a gift without pretending. Wear it only when you mean the smile.

💬 What's the last kind lie you told? 👇

An imagined reply. The Scripture is quoted as written.
